🇲🇽🌎 "They know we will not submit, neither to the interests of those who once plundered the country nor to any foreign power." "We are not decorative figures nor instruments of the powerful of yesteryear." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, 116th anniversary of the Mexican Revolution, Zócalo, Mexico City, Nov 20, 2026 Back from the APEC summit in China, Sheinbaum told the Zócalo she had made it clear to the world that Mexico "is showing that there is another path to development, one where economic success is not measured only in production figures, but in the well-being of families; where investment translates into rights and wealth into justice for all." "We are building our own model."
banner: "WE WILL NOT SUBMIT TO ANY FOREIGN POWER"

text: 🇲🇽🌎 "The development of one country cannot be above another country. It's not that one country grows at the expense of others." "We cannot talk about the development of artificial intelligence if it does not go through reducing poverty and inequalities in the whole world." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, closing press conference of the APEC 2026 trip, Shenzhen, China, Nov 19, 2026 Closing her APEC trip, Sheinbaum explained the message she brought to the forum: the Mexican Constitution sets a foreign policy of cooperation for development, so that "the prosperity of one country attracts the prosperity of other countries." APEC 2026 was held under the theme "Shared Prosperity."

🇲🇽🌎 "The coup ended the first democratic government of the Revolution and was an attack on national sovereignty." "In the conspiracy, the US ambassador Henry Lane Wilson intervened; he took part in the negotiations that led to the Embassy Pact to overthrow the constitutional government." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, 116th anniversary of the Mexican Revolution, Zócalo, Mexico City, Nov 20, 2026 At the 116th anniversary of the Revolution, Sheinbaum recounted the "Decena Trágica" of February 1913: Victoriano Huerta betrayed President Francisco I. Madero, who was forced to resign along with Vice President José María Pino Suárez, and both were then murdered. "It was a painful lesson. Democracy must include social justice; if not, there is no democracy."

🇲🇽✊ "The best news they can give the President of Mexico is that poverty is decreasing in Mexico." "I think some people didn't like it that much, but we should all be happy, truly, because this is very good news for the whole country." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, closing press conference of the APEC 2026 trip, Shenzhen, China, Nov 19, 2026 Asked in Shenzhen about the World Bank estimate that more than 17 million Mexicans have left poverty since 2018, Sheinbaum called it recognition of "what the moral economy means, what Mexican Humanism means, Plan México," and of what Mexico is doing so that prosperity reaches every Mexican.

🇲🇽🌎 "It is a new era, an era of cooperation that lets us improve the relationship and learn from the advances China has, and also lets China know what we are doing in Mexico." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, closing press conference of the APEC 2026 trip, Shenzhen, China, Nov 19, 2026 Mexico and China signed memorandums of understanding on environment and climate (river cleanup, solid waste), energy (solar-thermal, geothermal, storage, smart grids), science (12-month exchanges of young researchers) and international cooperation. A health agreement is in the works, and Mexico proposed 2027 as a Mexico–China Year of Tourism for 55 years of relations. Asked about Washington: "It will not affect Mexico's relationship with the United States." Mexico is not seeking a free-trade deal with China.
